targets.note: Measured on the 16 prints (on their mounts) behind the frames' UV glazing. By day the glass hall exceeds it (sheet section 4); measured, never tuned.
Measured on the four stereo cards on their readers.
Measured on the four autochromes (dyed starch-grain screens: highly fugitive colorants), lit only by transmitted daylight; 15,000 lx h a year.
The hall holds 50 lx works (ruled class). By day the glass gives far more; this is the electric floor after dusk (step lights and the vault's reflected wash). No walked line below escape-route.

design.note: At night the washed pearl lattice is the hall's brightest surface, at least 1.5 x the floor (the board: the uplights wash the pearl vault).
At night each framed print reads above the floor.
By day the sky through the vault is brighter than the gardens through the walls.
By day the autochromes glow by transmitted light, brighter than the prints' mounts.
